label: session
captain session
advisor session
builder session
definition: One Claude Code conversation in one role. The role names it: the captain session drives an approved plan, the advisor session grills the owner and writes the brief, a builder session implements one issue in its worktree. A session ends when its conversation ends; what outlives it is an issue, a commit or a report.
is_not: A role: the captain, the advisor and a builder are roles; a session is one conversation that plays one of them.
A worktree: a worktree is a checkout on disk; one session may work in it, and it stays after the session ends.
A sprint or a wave: those are units of work; a session is a unit of conversation.
